programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: From break up to make up, Jeff Gordon and Ray reunite to go on a quest to find their Chevrolet Monte Carlo that claimed victory in their final race together at Phoenix, AZ in 1999. John Bickford, Jeff Gordon’s stepdad, makes the call that reunites the old team. Jeff and Ray look to bum parts off their boss, Rick Hendrick, to make their vision a reality: get the car, replace the parts as they were, make it run and get it to auction.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: One of the greatest battles in NASCAR history was Hall of Famer Richie Evans and rival speedster Jerry Cook. Ray is determined to uncover and revive the cars that made these men famous.Ray purchases one of Richie’s original #61 modifieds from Jimmy Spencer and restores it to its original glory while simultaneously building a replica of Jerry Cook’s #38. Throughout the build process, Ray uncovers stories about these legends through the eyes of guys who were in Rome, NY to witness it firsthand, like Robin Pemberton and Steve Hmiel.Both cars will hit the track at Martinsville, site of one of the greatest races in modified history and the tragic death of Richie Evans himself. Legends live again, as Ray recreates one of the racing world’s most celebrated rivalries on a track that has seen it all.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: General Motors VP of global design Ed Welburn takes AmeriCarna behind the scenes to talk about the history and development of the company’s concept cars that never made it to production. In a rare tour of the factory’s inner design studio, Ray gets an exclusive look behind the creative curtain at the GM plant in Detroit.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: In this episode, Ray celebrates the 50th birthday of the Ford Mustang through the lens of three distinct Mustang owners, who each hold a slice of the car’s incredible history. In 1964, Chicago schoolteacher Gail Wise unknowingly purchased the first ever Mustang 3 days before the car became available to the general public. Her husband reveals the incredible restoration that brought the earliest Mustang ever sold back to its 60’s glory. (Ford Motor Company knows she has the car and has verified it was sold before it was legal to sell.) John Grafelman is a farmer in Illinois and life-long Ford lover. A few years ago he found an old car hidden in a barn. It took some time, but he eventually convinced his friend to sell it to him. After some detective work, he discovers he purchased 1968 Ford Design Chief Larry Shinoda’s personal car that he tinkered with to invent the BOSS 302.Lastly, Ray travels to Dayton Ohio to interview Gale Holderman, the Ford stylist who won the company’s contest to draw and design the Mustang.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Post-World War II, a large generation of American soldiers was looking for cars that mirrored the incredible sports cars they saw overseas in Europe. After searching for an affordable way to recreate these cars, one manufacturer responded with a durable, cost effective option: a line of fiberglass sports cars. Very few of these cars still exist but there are collectors who are constantly looking to save parts and pieces of these virtually unknown vehicles. We learn about these rare cars from Geoff Hacker and his team at Forgotten Fiberglass, and take a visit to the Smithsonian Museum, which houses a fiberglass car of its own. This episode presents a unique look at how the narrative of American wartime experiences often shaped the nation’s automotive demands.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Ray explores buying a unique, hand built car the Schultz family has kept in their New Jersey home for years. The car was originally called the Schultz El Fierro but it’s officially titled in New Jersey as a “Schultz Special” from 1958. It was used to drag race and held numerous racing records, but most important to the family was that it was driven by the legendary Carroll Shelby. With a frame and style much similar to the Shelby Roadster, the Schultz family wonders if it inspired one of the most well known automobiles in America. In another epic New Jersey story, Ray finds Mario Andretti’s 1965 IndyCar. The catch: it’s completely in pieces hidden away in a garage. The iconic driver talks about his days on the track with that car and Ray attempts to negotiate a deal to buy the parts.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Daimlers and Morgans, and Citroens, oh my! Caffeine & Octane is known for having something for everyone. That reputation grows stronger as Bob Boston’s collection, on the lunatic fringe of automotive, rattles into an event; guest host Katherine Legge explains the competitor to her racing sponsor Acura, Porsche.

programme.sub-title: C&O at the Beach - Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Early spring in Jekyll Island, GA is something to behold. Add a few hundred of the country’s coolest rides for Caffeine & Octane at the Beach, and it’s a thing of beauty. Models that blasted the glass ceiling of expectation at the all makes and models show include a hand-built, twin-turbo Tucker, a one-off 1951 Kaiser Drag’N, and a Roadkill Custom known only as Blasphemi!

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane

programme.desc: Caffeine & Octane is back at the beach on Jekyll Island with a focus on cars and families. Fathers & sons, with their barn-find Pilot House trucks and Plymouth Satellites, call cars the glue that keeps them bonded together with C&O being the best place to show them off.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.sub-title: Caffeine & Octane - SEMA: Inside Fuller's Head
programme.desc: On this edition of Caffeine & Octane, we’ll go inside the head of Master Builder Bryan Fuller at the SEMA car show, the largest annual trade show in the country; SEMA always brings out the best in the automotive industry. From a jaw dropping Javelin to a multimillion-dollar Pagani, Brian will prove to you, what happens in Vegas, doesn’t always stay in Vegas! Ryan Hardwick guest hosts and ventures deep into the C&O lots to find his favorite ride of the day.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Take apart and assemble a motor in less than 30 minutes? Sure, NASCAR pit crews can make the claim, but can a rag tag group of kids with names like Jelly Donut, Butter Bean, and Wonder Woman claim the pit fame? Host Rickey Gadson heads to the Sims Academy to settle a bet. This ultra fast half-hour edition of Caffeine & Octane also includes a builder’s take on an Ultra Four Unlimited Off-Road Racer; Ryan Hardwick joins the gang at Caffeine and Octane.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Demetrio Montalvo likes American music, American food, and especially American cars. Only one problem - Demetrio lives in Cuba. A Visa, bestowed to him from some American friends in high places, lets him travel to the States to search for tough to find automotive parts and attend his favorite car show. Showing up to Caffeine & Octane in a cool caddy is the easy part. Picking parts to take back home presents a unique set of challenges for the Cuban car builder; Formula Drift racer Federico Sceriffo brings the first ever Formula Drift Ferrari to C&O.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.sub-title: Caffeine & Octane - Magnus Walker's Secret Porsche Collection
programme.desc: Porsche collector, customizer, and Urban Outlaw, Magnus Walker is a world-wide rock star to fans of the German car company. So, when Caffeine & Octane producers invited him to travel cross country to tell the story of a hidden Porsche collection tangled in a North Georgia Vineyard, they were surprised when he signed on. No sour grapes here, what Walker found at the Wolf Mountain Winery will impress even those with the most refined palette for Porsches.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Acoso sin cuartel
programme.desc: La muerte de la soldado Vanessa Guillén ha provocado un movimiento nacional para hablar sobre un tema incómodo, la violencia sexual contra las mujeres en las fuerzas armadas, por años los abusos contra ellas han sido una epidemia sin control.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - El menos pensado
programme.desc: Juan Morales cansado de estar confinado en una silla de ruedas decidió desafiar su límites y se convirtió en el distribuidor de drogas de su escuela. Envuelto en violencia callejera, Juan logró salir adelante para volverse un psicólogo.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - El gran golpe
programme.desc: Una banda de asaltantes con armas de juguete se llevó casi veinte millones de dólares de las cajillas de seguridad de un banco, lo sorpendente es que no hubo heridos ni disparos.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Crímenes sin resolver
programme.desc: El tiempo parece moverse en cámara lenta para familiares, amigos y conocidos de personas que han sido víctimas de diferentes crímenes que, desgraciadamente, muchas veces no logran ser resueltos.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - El experimento
programme.desc: El bebé de Maritza Ramírez es secuestrado el día programado para nacer. En su fiesta de 16 años, los síntomas de la enfermedad de Helen reaparecen. Lumpkin, un pueblo olvidado es la ubicación de una cárcel de inmigrantes.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Radiografía de una masacre
programme.desc: Una familia destruida tras un inesperado ataque con armas de fuego, habla sobre todo el sufrimiento que tuvieron que pasar al perder a sus seres queridos en manos de organizaciones delictivas. Una de las masacres más sangrientas y terribles de México.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Fentanilo la nueva apuesta del narco
programme.desc: México es país productor y de tránsito de Fentanilo, un opioide sintético el cual es cada vez más consumido en Estados Unidos. Esta droga causa muchas muertes entre jóvenes. Un kilo de fentanilo genera las mismas ganancias que una tonelada de cocaína.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Desaparecidos de la frontera
programme.desc: Ante la incompetencia de las autoridades, familiares se han convertido en investigadores privados aficionados dispuestos a enfrentar riesgos, ellos dicen vivir una carrera contra el tiempo para evitar que sus seres queridos desaparezcan para siempre.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - El hijo de El Chapo captura y liberación de un intocable
programme.desc: El ejército mexicano despliega un operativo en Culiacán, Sinaloa para detener a un familiar de Joaquín Guzmán Loera 'El Chapo'. El objetivo es capturado, durante un día Culiacán queda atrapado en un enfrentamiento entre el ejército y los narcos.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Emprendiendo sueños
programme.desc: Dos hermanas convirtieron una deliciosa receta de su madre en un gran negocio. Un hombre pasó de ser astronauta a cultivar las mejores uvas para hacer vino.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - La oscura luz del mundo
programme.desc: Tras múltiples denuncias una red de oscuros secretos y abusos a menores es descubierta, los líderes de una iglesia se ven envueltos en terribles crímenes que tendrán que pagar en prisión.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Exonerados: años perdidos
programme.desc: El tráfico ilegal de personas entre República Dominicana y Puerto Rico ha aumentado en los últimos meses, las autoridades hacen todo lo que pueden para mejorar la situación.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Atracción fatal
programme.desc: Un hombre habla sobre el infierno que vivió con la desaparición de su esposa, pues no solo sufría por ella al no saber donde estaba, también tuvo que lidiar con el hecho de que se convirtió en el principal sospechoso.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Edición especial: Cinco secretos, gran sacrificio
programme.desc: Entre lágrimas, un pequeño niño le confiesa a su madre adoptiva que quiere volver con su familia biológica. Estrellas latinas del Cirque du Soleil hablan sobre el cambio drástico en sus vidas tras la pandemia, pues se vieron obligadas a dejar los shows.

programme.title: La Fea Más Bella Capítulo 46
programme.desc: El papa de Leticia le cuenta a Fernando que él lleva la contabilidad de Filmo Imagen. El Club de las Feas sospecha que Alicia está esperando un hijo de Omar. Lety y Fernando presentan al notario la deuda que Conceptos tiene con Filmo Imagen.

programme.title: La Fea Más Bella Capítulo 47
programme.desc: La familia de Martha le da un cheque para comprarse un coche. Marcia le cuenta a Fernando que Alicia está embarazada y Fernando se lo cuenta a Omar. Fernando y Lety acuden a una agencia para conseguir un crédito para el equipo de filmación.

programme.title: La Fea Más Bella Capítulo 48
programme.desc: Marcia le dice a Fernando que Bella Life y la agencia de publicidad aceptaron que Conceptos se encargue de lanzar la campaña. Las secretarias convencen a Martha de hacerse una liposucción. Conceptos logra filmar el primer comercial de la campaña.

programme.title: La Fea Más Bella Capítulo 49
programme.desc: Omar le recomienda a Fernando un abogado para que represente a Filmo Imagen en el proceso de embargo a Conceptos. Omar le da un cheque a Alicia para ayudarla con el embarazo. Paula María le promete a su hijo conseguirle un papá.

programme.title: La Fea Más Bella Capítulo 50
programme.desc: Las chicas del Club de las Feas sospechan que Alicia no está embarazada. El abogado de Filmo Imagen hace efectiva la demanda de embargo precautorio a Conceptos. Fernando tiene muchos remordimientos por la grave situación económica de Conceptos.

programme.title: La Fea Más Bella Capítulo 51
programme.desc: El esposo de Martha se decepciona porque ella decidió operarse en lugar de comprarse un carro. Los papás de Fernando llegan de viaje y le piden un informe acerca de la situación de la empresa. Simón intenta que incluyan a Jazmín en la coreografía.

programme.title: La Fea Más Bella Capítulo 52
programme.desc: Alicia se realiza los análisis de sangre que le solicitó la empresa. Fernando le presenta a sus padres un informe maquillado acerca de la situación de la empresa. El abogado de Filmo Imagen y el notario público se presentan en Conceptos.

programme.title: La Fea Más Bella Capítulo 53
programme.desc: Lety le pide discreción al licenciado Sánchez para levantar el embargo de las instalaciones de Conceptos. En el ensayo del comercial, Fátima le coquetea a Fernando y Marcia se lo reclama.

programme.title: La Fea Más Bella Capítulo 54
programme.desc: Fernando le pide a Luigi despedir a Fátima, pero él se niega. Marcia le reclama a Lety no tener efectivo para los pagos que necesita realizar. Fernando está muy intrigado respecto al supuesto novio de Lety e investiga con el Cuartel de las Feas.

programme.title: La Fea Más Bella Capítulo 55
programme.desc: Fernando está preocupado porque supone que Tomás Mora es el amor platónico de Lety. Todos los empleados de Conceptos trabajan para el lanzamiento del comercial de Bella Life. El Cuartel de las Feas descubre que Alicia no está embarazada.

programme.title: La Fea Más Bella Capítulo 56
programme.desc: Luigi despide a Fátima por emborracharse antes de la presentación y le pide a Jazmín que la sustituya. Las secretarias del Club de las Feas quieren entrar a la presentación, pero no tienen invitación.

programme.title: La Fea Más Bella Capítulo 57
programme.desc: Omar convence a Fernando para dejar entrar a las secretarias a la presentación. El Club de las Feas le entrega los resultados de la prueba de embarazo a Alicia y la obligan a contárselo a Omar. Don Erasmo y Tomás van a recoger a Lety al evento.

programme.title: La Fea Más Bella Capítulo 58
programme.desc: Omar le recomienda a Fernando enamorar a Lety para asegurar su fidelidad y complicidad en el manejo de Conceptos. Ariel le exige a Alicia que renuncie a la empresa y ella lo amenaza con contarle todo a Fernando y Marcia.

programme.title: Realtree Roadtrips
programme.sub-title: Road Trips - "FIRST SIT In Mississippi | Austin Riley Smokes A GIANT | Realtree Road Trips"
programme.desc: Atlanta Braves' third baseman Austin Riley is usually spending his September and October holding it down on the hot corner in the MLB playoffs. Being that he can't hunt much during the early part of deer season, he usually hunts hard during December and January in Mississippi. This year was no different. He jumped at the opportunity to head down to the Backwoods testing grounds to hunt with the Small Town TV crew in Yazoo City. Austin capitalizes on a first sit opportunity on a true Mississippi giant over a Backwoods Attraction food plot! Three first sit bucks taken for the Road Trips crew at the Backwoods testing grounds!

programme.title: Realtree Roadtrips
programme.sub-title: Road Trips - "A MONARCH Of A Buck | Bowhunting Louisiana | Realtree Road Trips"
programme.desc: Tyler Jordan is hunting a true giant at one of his favorite places to hunt in the Southeast. Honeybrake has been a great place to deer hunt for the Realtree crew over the last few years. Tyler Jordan and Ben McDonald decide to try their luck bowhunting at Honeybrake for a couple true southern ghosts.

programme.title: Realtree Roadtrips
programme.sub-title: Road Trips - "UNDERTAKER Hunting Sandhill Cranes | Catch Clean Cook | Ribeye Of The Sky RECIPE"
programme.desc: Realtree's David Blanton is joined by WWE's Mark Calaway aka "Undertaker" for a sandhill crane hunt in Texas. The crew put the Franchi Shotguns to work and were able to harvest the "Ribeye of the Sky." Check out the hunt and an awesome, simple recipe to enjoy sandhill crane for dinner!

programme.title: Realtree Roadtrips
programme.desc: Join Michael Pitts and Rigsby Stewart as they battle through the highs and lows of a tough Kentucky bowhunting season.

programme.title: Realtree Roadtrips
programme.sub-title: Road Trips - "Hunting Tough Alabama Turkeys | Big Gobbler Finally Breaks | Realtree Road Trips"
programme.desc: Tyler Jordan hunts with country music singer Riley Green on his farm in Jacksonville, Alabama. The first couple days of turkey season are met with difficult conditions, and they struggle to find turkeys that are willing to work. High winds make for rough hunting.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: It’s that time again—when the boys from StruttinBuck load up and head out of Arkansas, bound for Fairfield, Texas and the FE Hill Ranch. Another year, another hunt, and another chapter in a tradition that’s grown into something far bigger than the hunt itself. This annual father-son trip is built on early mornings, shared stories, and moments that stick with you long after the season ends. It’s the memories made over the years that keep calling them back—and this year will be no different.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We join Blake Barnett alongside hunter Jimmy Reynolds as they take part in the 2nd Annual Pierce Dutton Memorial Hunt. This meaningful whitetail hunt is made possible by the great folks at Disabled Outdoorsmen. Jimmy settles in at the G2 Ranch in South Texas, where prime whitetail country and a shared passion for the outdoors set the stage for an unforgettable hunt.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We’re back with Double T Outfitters for this episode of Storytellers, filmed at the beautiful Las Lagunas Ranch in South Texas! This hunt was one to remember as we spent time with the Price family, including Logan—our Show Your Skull Showdown winner from last season! From unforgettable hunts and incredible wildlife to evenings around hunting camp with amazing people, this trip was filled with memories that will last a lifetime. A huge thank you to Double T Outfitters for your incredible hospitality and for your continued support of TTHA. Partnerships like yours help make experiences like this possible. This episode is packed with great hunting, genuine friendships, and the stories that make the outdoors so special.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We’re kicking off a special weekend at Legends Ranch in Bitely, Michigan — bringing together two groups connected by a shared respect for the outdoors. Legends Ranch has always stood for strong conservation values, and when you combine that with the work being done by the SCI Foundation and Sables, it sets the tone for something bigger than just a hunt. Sables members are deeply involved in shaping the future of hunting — reaching into classrooms, working with young people, collaborating with wildlife professionals, and engaging leaders at both the state and national level. Their efforts are centered on helping others understand wildlife diversity, the principles behind the North American Model of Wildlife Conservation, and the role hunting plays in maintaining balance in the wild. They’re also helping keep the tradition alive — showing that hunting still has a strong place in today’s culture and communities. With that kind of purpose behind it, this weekend is about more than time in the field — it’s about continuing something that matters.

programme.desc: The Surgeon General’s Advisory stated, before the COVID-19 pandemic, mental health challenges were the leading cause of disability and poor life outcomes in young people. How do parents and schools play a role? Some experts believe young people were never taught how to fend for themselves because they were raised in a bubble by “concierge parents“ who protected them from learning about life and developing resiliency. She admits she was overprotected in some ways growing up, which she believes led to struggles with anxiety and depression for the past six years. What does she reveal for the first time? Also, parents of teens with mental health struggles talk about their frustrations. This is a life-saving episode you won’t want to miss.
